title: Observe reaction recording cancellation before structural parsing
decision: Implement only cancellation-before-parser ordering. Keep demanded cold speech, preparation readiness, captions, native decoding, priorities, memory limits and deadlines unchanged. Safe-phase scheduling and worker changes remain profiling-dependent.

finding.trigger: Abort while Blob.arrayBuffer() is pending; existing await resumes into inspectRecordingContainer before observing the aborted signal.
finding.effect: Abandoned recordings still incur structural parsing. Malformed late bytes produce an unsupported-container error before cancellation is observed.
finding.concreteScope: Split await of bytes from parsing and check the same AbortSignal immediately after the awaited read; retain the existing post-parser cancellation check.
notClaimed: No measured parser timing or browser performance acceptance.
No prevention of already-running byte read or native decode.
No change to library.resolve base64 decoding or future cache readiness.
No cancellation of another owner's operation.

validation.mode: RAM-only source parse, format and ESLint checks; no local test/application execution
validation.productionDiff: +3 -1 lines; no other production owner changes
newControlNames: recording cancellation before inspection does not read bytes or create media
cancellation during byte reading wins over a later malformed container
an uncancelled malformed recording retains structural validation
an uncancelled recording keeps metadata inspection and owned URL cleanup
cache cancellation owns a pending byte read until it settles and starts no media or decode
uncancelled demanded speech still prepares while playing with one decode and no playback

supersedes.reason: Peer-requested deterministic release-and-settle cleanup for both intentionally held byte reads, including assertion-failure paths.

revisionNotes: Both held-read tests register t.after before their first awaited assertion boundary.
Cleanup cancels the owned request, resolves the byte gate and awaits the already-observed promise(s); cache owner then disposes and closes its own preparation.
All six test names and production bytes remain unchanged.
